title: Arsenal's Gritty Barcelona Draw Could Be a Turning Point
body:
Arsenal drew with European champions Barcelona, and the BBC has framed it as a gritty display that showed a different side of the team [S1]. The question the coverage asks is whether a resilient result against opposition of that quality can mark the point where a season changes direction [S1].

The league numbers give the claim some real substance. Arsenal have won their last five league matches, collecting 15 points [ST1]. Across that run they have scored 7 and conceded only 1, with the sequence reading WWWWW [ST1].

That is the sort of run that changes how a squad sees itself. The defensive record is the part to watch. A team that stops giving chances can absorb pressure, and absorbing pressure is what title challenges are built on.

Still, the evidence has limits. The form figures cover league matches only [ST1], and the BBC piece is a single report on one draw [S1]. Neither proves the season has turned, so keep the party hats in the box for now.

The Touchline Take: the grit is real, the form is hot, and it is one to keep an eye on as the season unfolds.
